source: THIRD-PARTY public data (Apple ARKitScenes, visit 421380), not our capture. Supplementary validation only.
measured_with: Static laser scan 170107 (ARKitScenes), every 20th point; wall faces = histogram peaks of PCA-normal points (tools/laser_gt.py), read from out/laser_gt/room_zoom.png
note: N and E walls fully observed corner to corner. S wall seen from x~0.3 to the E corner and W wall to z~1.6; an opening (open door / glass) at the SW corner hides the rest, so S and W assume the rectangle continues. Openings omitted: jambs not clearly visible, so a width would be invented.
note_frames: gt_faces positions are in the laser frame produced by tools/laser_gt.py load_aligned()
